en: From "Danball Senki W" comes Yamano Ban's LBX Odin Mk-2! Restored with the original Runner specifications intact!

● 1/1 LBX Odin Mk-2 is back! The color coding of the main body is reproduced with molding colors and seals. ● Comes with a special pedestal! ● "Restrator" and "NEO Beam Garter" are included! ● Can transform from normal form to flight form! By linking with the LBX Achilles D9 (sold separately), it is also possible to reproduce the "double lay wing".
